acceptance_checks.description: ow_tp_demo.customers holds exactly 25000 documents for ns=demo, recomputed from Atlas
Order-independent md5 over the migrated customer line format equals manifest checksum 4f92feef2ad58dbab30e289957931928 for the fields carried across
All 8333 ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE rows appear as typed entries inside the customers.attributes subdocument; no EAV row is dropped
RELATED_ACCT_IDS is a BSON array of strings on every document where the source value was well formed
SIGNUP_DT is a BSON date on every document where the source string parsed; unparseable values never fail open to a plausible date
Every quarantined record names its source primary key and the anomaly id that quarantined it
A second migration run leaves counts, checksums and the quarantine set byte-identical

planted_anomalies.description: 50 unparseable SIGNUP_DT strings (31-FEB-24, N/A, ...) must be detected and quarantined, not coerced
31 malformed RELATED_ACCT_IDS CSV lists must be detected and quarantined, not silently truncated

encoding_policy.input_encoding: UTF-8 as read through python-oracledb from the AL32UTF8 database
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Source text is carried through unchanged; no normalization, trimming, or case folding of business values
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: A value that cannot be decoded is quarantined with the raw bytes hex-encoded; it is never replaced by a lossy substitute character

malformed_record_policy.details: Malformed CSV list values are tolerated at the row level but attributed into the quarantine collection with their anomaly id. A NULL or missing source value may never fail open into a valid-looking document: absent means the field is absent, and a required field that is absent fails the record into quarantine.

empty_input_semantics.details: A run that reads zero source rows leaves prior Atlas output untouched and exits non-zero, because at demo scale an empty read is a source-connectivity failure rather than a legitimate state.
